independent_computation.step_0_scope_limit: The permitted evidence tree (data/ + docs/math-foundations.md) does NOT contain the golden scenario definition: scripts/golden_snapshot.py and scripts/golden_baseline.json are out of bounds, and no file under data/ names 'syndra_custom_order_60', 'manual_target' or 'target_ending_health' (grep -r returned nothing). The scenario's attacker level, item build, ability ranks, cast order, and the manually-entered target health/armor/MR are therefore NOT directly observable. What follows is a from-sources reconstruction of the 650.0 delta plus a wiki-rule adjudication of its direction, not a full re-simulation of the scenario.

step_1_verify_the_wiki_formula_read.claim: The W Transcendent bonus is 'deal 12% (+ 2% per 100 AP) bonus true damage', taken on Force of Will's own magic damage (not on target max health).
step_1_verify_the_wiki_formula_read.result: Exact match on all five ranks for both the flat and the AP term, and the cached 'Total Mixed Damage' row (78.4/112/... = 1.12 * base; 74.2% AP = 65 + 9.2) is the magic+true sum. The 12%-of-own-damage reading is confirmed by the cache; the alternative '% of target max health' reading is ruled out.

active_at_exactly_60: Q: second Dark Sphere charge (threshold 40 — S3), so Q may be cast twice back-to-back
W: bonus true damage 12% + 2% per 100 AP (threshold 60 — S4; 'Collecting 60' is inclusive at 60)
NOT_active_at_60: E enhanced scatter (80) — utility only in any case
step_2_what_60_splinters_means_per_the_w.consequence: Any engine behavior at splinters=60 that prices the 120-splinter +15% AP buff would be wrong; any behavior that omits the 40-splinter second Dark Sphere charge or the 60-splinter W true damage is also wrong (too little damage).

step_3_magnitude_reconstruction.constraint_A: delta = 650.0 exactly. Post-mitigation magic damage is raw * 100/(100+MR) (S7); an integer delta therefore points at either true damage or a magic row against a 0-MR target. 'manual_target' is the hand-entered-target fight, where a 0-MR dummy is the natural setup.
step_3_magnitude_reconstruction.constraint_B: Both endpoints end in .6, so total damage dealt ends in .4 in BOTH runs; the fractional part of the damage path is unchanged by the change.
step_3_magnitude_reconstruction.test_of_the_60_splinter_W_bonus_as_the_w: Solving (0.12+0.0002*AP)*(190+0.65*AP) = 650 gives AP ~ 1795 for a single rank-5 W cast (and ~1896 at rank 1) — physically unreachable. So the 650 delta is NOT a single W true-damage packet; the W bonus alone cannot explain it.
step_3_magnitude_reconstruction.test_of_one_extra_dark_sphere: Q rank 5 raw = 230 + 0.70*AP (S2). 230 + 0.70*600 = 650.0 exactly. At AP = 600 every other Syndra row is also an integer (W magic 190+390 = 580; E 200+360 = 560; R rank3 per sphere 160+120 = 280, 3-sphere minimum 480+360 = 840; AD is integer-rounded per S7), and the ONLY fractional term in the whole path is the 60-splinter W true damage: (0.12+0.0002*600)*580 = 0.24*580 = 139.2 per cast. Two W casts contribute 278.4 — a .4 fractional tail, exactly matching constraint_B, and unchanged by adding an integer 650.
step_3_magnitude_reconstruction.conclusion_of_the_reconstruction: delta 650.0 = one additional rank-5 Dark Sphere cast at 600 AP against a 0-MR manual target — i.e. the second Q charge that the wiki grants at 40+ Splinters (S3) and that is therefore available at splinters=60. Alternative clean fits (E rank5 at AP=750, Q rank1 at AP=800) require either a duplicated E or an unmaxed Q, and the AP=750 fit needs 8 W casts to reproduce the .4 tail, so they are strictly worse explanations.

step_4_direction_adjudication.question: Is the extra 650 damage wiki-supported at splinters = 60?
step_4_direction_adjudication.answer: Yes. At 60 Splinters of Wrath both Transcendent bonuses below the threshold are live: the Dark Sphere second charge (40) and the W true damage (60). A fight that casts only one Dark Sphere when two charges are stocked under-prices the rotation. The change moves the number in the direction the cached wiki text requires (more damage, lower target ending health).
step_4_direction_adjudication.counter_hypothesis_examined: If the change had instead switched on the 120-splinter Transcendence +15% AP buff at 60 splinters, that WOULD be wrong (S1/S5/S6 put that buff at 120). But a 15% AP buff is a multiplicative re-scaling of every AP-scaled row; it cannot land on an exact integer 650.0 while leaving the fractional tail of the total identical (constraint_B), and it would not be expressible as a single ability row. This hypothesis is rejected by the arithmetic.
step_4_direction_adjudication.residual_risk: Because the scenario tuple is not in the permitted evidence tree, I cannot rule out that the extra Dark Sphere is scheduled at a moment the game would not allow (e.g. the charge not yet recharged — Q rechargeRate 7s, and R's passive grants Dark Sphere 10/20/30 ability haste). That is a scheduling question, not a damage-row question; the damage-row value 650.0 is exactly right for the sphere itself.

confidence: medium — the 650.0 delta is exactly and uniquely explained by a sourced Syndra ability row that the cached wiki text says is available at 60 Splinters of Wrath, and the direction (more damage) is the direction the wiki demands; but the scenario's input tuple lives in scripts/ (out of bounds for this oracle), so this is a sources-grounded reconstruction rather than a full independent re-simulation.
what_would_raise_confidence: The scenario tuple (level, ranks, item build / manual AP, cast order, manual target health-armor-MR) — if AP resolves to 600 and the manual target MR is 0, the reconstruction becomes an exact recomputation.
